newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola shares slump as Q2 meets estimates.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola shares slump as Q2 meets estimates.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co shares were down 1-3/8 to 69-1/2 in afternoon trading though its Q2 results released early Thursday met or slightly exceeded Wall Street analysts' estimates.
Coca-Cola reported earnings of $0.53 per share, up from $0.42 from the same period a year ago, and above the First Call consensus estimate of $0.51.

"You always get a little profit taking" when a company reports results, said Credit Suisse First Boston analyst Martin Romm. "The earnings were good. The bottom line is, the company continues to be very much on track."
Smith Barney analyst Sandra Kim said Coca-Cola's results "are pretty much in line -- a solid quarter, fairly good volume, no big surprises."
Smith Barney will maintain its "outperform" rating on Coca-Cola.
"We think they are well-positioned for the third quarter," she said.
